description: Release smoke: the thin scenario package fixtures/scenario-package/smoke/richmond-public.scenario.zip, whose closures resolve from the public stores: registry release richmond-field-station@v5 (release b3a37eaf..., canonical 5d94b1db..., web c5f039e0...) and actor closure 793ec86c. The scenario is edge case 06 (wrong-way vehicle, blind approach) instantiated with the simforge CLI on v5 and simulated there (trace format 5, engine 0.12.1, on the release's ground and colliders); the package re-simulates to its own trace. The scene-state stream is the CLI's own render lowering of the package timeline (`simforge render` job sceneState, 24 fps over 0..1 s, 24 ticks), passed through unchanged. Corpus: SIMFORGE_CORPUS_RICHMOND_V5 = the v5 native master (.corpus/richmond-field-station after `simforge maps pull richmond-field-station@v5`; master.gltf 017dc743...). Chase camera 9 m behind and 3 m above the focus vehicle; tick 12 is hashed. `recording: unrecorded` until SPLIT/R records it on lavapipe with the v0.2.0-rc.0 renderer; while unrecorded, verify fails with exit 10, never passes.
